sheet_2_layout.description: The R_MonthlySales screen is designed to display and summarize monthly sales data, providing users with an overview of the sales performance over a specific period.
sheet_2_layout.timing: This screen is used when the user needs to review and analyze monthly sales data, typically at the end of a month or for periodic business reviews.

process_overview.summary_line: The user accesses the R_MonthlySales screen to view the summarized monthly sales data.
The screen presents the sales data in a readable format, allowing the user to identify trends and insights.
